metric_confirmed: 05/11/2026 Luiz: decide on the distance that takes ALL axes into account (dx, dy, dz) = pos3d. pos3d = per-step sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + alt_err^2) averaged over the episode (controller/cpu_score.rs:431; rivals position_score.rs:304). Decided after 2/5 pairs (s2, s3) — arm wins under pos3d AND horizontal on both, so the choice does not depend on the data seen. Supersedes the design doc's 'horizontal' wording; dx/dy stay reported.

rule_v2.amended: 05/11/2026 ~07:30 EST by Luiz, after 2/5 pairs (s2, s3) and BEFORE twin_s4 finished. Replaces 'rule' (single-metric pos3d gate).
rule_v2.principle: Compare the controllers as a WHOLE on all metrics (stable, err, steady, pos3d; alt/dx/dy reported). pos3d is the TIE-BREAKER only when stable/err/steady are similar.
decision: 1. ATTITUDE BLOCK (stable, err, steady; paired arm-twin means, 95% two-sided t CI): if every metric is better-or-similar for one side and at least one is better beyond its margin (CI clear of the margin), that side WINS regardless of pos3d.
2. If all three are similar (CIs inside the margins) -> pos3d decides (lower wins).
3. Mixed (one better beyond margin, another worse beyond margin) -> no automatic verdict; report to Luiz.
rule_v2.stopping: One interim look at n=3 (s2-s4): if step 1 gives a verdict with all three attitude CIs clear of their margins in the same direction, STOP (cancel s5/s6). Otherwise continue to n=5 and apply the same rule. Disclosed: one interim look slightly inflates the error rate.
